text:
jen: Quick follow-up from the regional failover postmortem. Capturing owners + short deadlines for runbook & restore tasks. I'll run weekly check-ins. High level: validate cross-region backups, confirm LB routing + DNS TTL behavior, test DB restore runbook, and schedule a small DR game day for canary apps. IDs below.
mike: Ack. I'll take S3 cross-region replication and restore script. Target 2026-04-09 for validation. PR: https://git.redwood/infrastructure/replication/pull/42
mike: Test command I plan to use: ```./scripts/restore-test --src us-west-2 --dst eu-central-1 --bucket redwood-prod-backups --prefix nightly/2026-04-01``` Will post logs in the infra runbook.
sasha: I'll own LB routing + traffic-shift playbook. Need to confirm health-check behaviors under low DNS TTL and ALB failover. Proposed deadline 2026-04-12. Note: include an emergency rollback step that re-routes to previous region.
kevin: I'll do DB snapshot restore runbook (Postgres). Steps I want to add: restore to read-replica, promote, run smoke SQL checks. Suggested smoke query: `SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE created_at > now() - interval '1 day'`
kevin: Also propose a dry-run window: 2026-04-15 03:00-04:00 PST (low traffic). Anyone object?
sasha: fine with dry-run window. I'll coordinate with product to freeze writes for 15 minutes.
jen: @infra-bot, create recurring reminder weekly on Mondays for the DR follow-up thread.
infra-bot: Created reminder: 'DR follow-ups - runbook verifications' every Monday 10:00 AM UTC starting 2026-04-05.
mike: Quick note on metrics: we should capture time-to-restore and cache-warmup token errors. I'll add dashboards: /dashboards/dr-restore-latency and tag alerts for >30m restore time.
jen: Owners summary: mike = S3/backup restores (deadline 2026-04-09), kevin = DB restore runbook + dry run (deadline 2026-04-14), sasha = LB routing and traffic-shift (deadline 2026-04-12), jen = orchestration + schedule DR game day (propose 2026-04-20).
mike: I'll post a short PR with the runbook commands and expected outputs. Blocker: need temporary extra storage quota in eu-central-1 for the test (+2TB). @infra-team can we get that?
kevin: If infra can't do storage quota, we can spin ephemeral PG instances in the same region to simulate restore without copying full dataset. Will follow up in PR.
sasha: Add checklist item: update public runbook to include DNS TTL change steps, expected propagation timelines, and rollback notes. I'll take that.
jen: Great. I'll follow up with calendar invites for the dry-run and game day and update the postmortem with owners. If anyone finishes earlier ping here with result logs. :thumbsup:
